description: This file defines the CodeIndexServiceFactory class responsible for creating and configuring dependencies for code indexing, including embedders, vector stores, directory scanners, and file watchers, based on project configuration.

classes.name: CodeIndexServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and configuring code indexing service dependencies, including embedders, vector stores, scanners, and watchers based on configuration.

methods.name: createEmbedder
methods.description: Creates an embedder instance based on current configuration, selecting among various provider options.

methods.name: validateEmbedder
methods.description: Validates an embedder instance to ensure proper configuration, capturing telemetry on errors.

methods.name: createVectorStore
methods.description: Creates a vector store instance based on configuration, supporting LanceDB and Qdrant.

methods.name: createDirectoryScanner
methods.description: Creates a directory scanner with dependencies and configurable batch size and retries.

methods.name: createFileWatcher
methods.description: Creates a file watcher with dependencies and configurable batch size and retries.

methods.name: createServices
methods.description: Creates all required service dependencies if the feature is properly configured, throwing errors otherwise.
